description: Read Firmware-authored supported chains, public account schemes, and supported signing methods over an approved session. Resolves the target device by deviceId, by purpose, or by the default active device. Requires a prior connect_device approval; returns 'not_connected' without contacting Firmware when there is no Agent-Q runtime session. signing.authorization is Firmware-authored read-only state and is not a request option.
